description.narrative: Projektets mål är (a) att stödja nationalförsamlingens institutionella kapacitet och strategiska kommunikation och rikta in sig på oberoende organ (revisionskammaren och Human Rights Defender's Office) för att driva framåt den moderna offentliga politiska agendan och förbättra utförandet av dess kärnfunktioner; (b) stärka den relevanta kompetensen hos parlamentsledamöterna och personalen i nationalförsamlingen.

The objectives of the Project are (a) supporting the institutional capacities and strategic communication of the National Assembly and target independent bodies (Chamber of Audit and Human Rights Defender's Office) to drive forward the modern public policy agenda and improve performance of its core functions; (b) enhancing the relevant competencies of the MPs and the staff of the National Assembly.

The project will aim at supporting the institutional capacities and strategic communication and collaboration of the National Assembly and target independent bodies (Chamber of Audit and Ombudsperson) to drive forward modern public policy agenda and improve performance of its core functions. It will enhance the relevant competencies of the MPs, and the staff of the National Assembly. The project is based on the previous cooperation with the NA and the respective lessons learned. The project efforts will focus on enhancing the institutional capacity of the National Assembly to fulfill its constitutional duties in more inclusive, responsive, transparent, accountable, and effective way, including, in engaging with citizens, civil society and public sector.
Outcome: The National Assembly is more inclusive, responsive, transparent, accountable and effective.
Result 1. Strategic vision of the National Assembly and roadmap for reforms, strategic communication and collaboration are consolidated empowering modern public policy agenda and fostering inclusive practices.
Result 2. The National Assembly is equipped with state-of-the-art methods and instruments for effectively pursuing its modern public policy agenda and improving performance of its core functions.
Result 3. Competencies of the MPs and the staff of the National Assembly in utilizing innovative methods, using and producing knowledge products towards advancing the modern public policy agenda and enhancing effectiveness of their core functions strengthened.
The project will design and introduce digitalised solutions to streamline functions and processes of the independent bodies, and facilitate collaboration with the National Assembly. It will build the capacities of the members and the target staff of the Audit Chamber and Ombudsperson office to enable them to engage with the modern public policy agenda, enhance the oversight function and promote rights-based approach to public policy making respectively, through applying new competencies of effective communication and stakeholder engagement.

The project will build on the results achieved of the project Modern Parliament for a Modern Armenia (MAP 1.0), implemented by UNDP during 2019-2023, which aimed at strengthening the NA in carrying out its key functions of legislating, oversight, and representation. The current application is designed utilizing extensively the lessons learned through this effort and building on the results achieved and strategic partnerships developed throughout 2019-2023.
The expected outcome of the contribution is the NA is more inclusive, responsive, transparent, accountable, and effective. The project efforts will focus on enhancing the institutional capacity of the National Assembly to fulfil its constitutional duties in more inclusive, responsive, transparent, accountable, and effective way, including, in engaging with citizens, civil society and public sector. Result-based management matrix is integrated into the monitoring and evaluation matrix, which is further discussed in partner capacity section. The achievement of this outcome will be measured vis-a-vis nine targets. Thus, by 2028, the project will result in at least 7 percent increase in the following scores of the Index of the Parliament Perception (IPP): (a) Public Participation Score; (b) Parliamentary Responsiveness Score; (c) Parliamentary Transparency Score; (d) Parliamentary Accountability Score; (e) Parliamentary Effectiveness Score; (f) Public Awareness Score. Sida assess that the project gaol/objectives presented in the form of outcome/outputs are realistic and measurable to achieve through implementation of the activities under each result area.
